purpose: Convert observed worker failures into measured repairs before any increase in agent count.

cycle.input: same problem and same worker count

cycle.output: specialization vector, novelty score, redundancy links, invariant capsule

cycle.input: two quality passes + marginal information gain

cycle.output: versioned checkpoint with parent SHA and rollback

repair_rule: Change the smallest layer responsible for the observed failure; do not add agents to compensate for a broken worker contract.
scale_rule: Two consecutive quality passes at scale 5 are required before considering 10; 10 must show positive marginal information gain before considering 20.
evidence_rule: A workflow SUCCESS is infrastructure evidence only. Quality requires receipt-level semantic gates.
aelys_role: AELYS may propose improvements from measured failures but its self-report is never sufficient evidence for promotion.

gvl.rule: Vectorize validated lesson, measure redundancy/novelty, require held-out transfer gain, then promote invariant capsule only.
